meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: Claude 会去查 claude-mem 保存的跨会话记忆库:先用 search 拿到带 ID 的索引,再用 timeline 看某条记录前后的上下文,最后只对筛出来的 ID 用 get_observations 取完整记录。
howto.when: 当问题指向以前的会话、而不是当前对话时触发,例如“这个我们之前修过吗”“上次 X 是怎么做的”等。

say.text: 这个报错我们之前解决过吗?
say.note: 先搜索索引,再按需取详情

say.text: 上周这个项目都改了什么?
say.note: 按日期范围搜索观察记录

say.text: 用 /knowledge-agent 总结一下认证相关的历史
say.note: 生成可追问的语料并对话式回答

howto.what_en: Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory: search returns an index with IDs, timeline shows context around a record, then get_observations fetches full details only for the filtered IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the question is about previous sessions, not the current conversation, e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we do X last time?"

say_en.text: Did we already solve this error?
say_en.note: Searches the index, then fetches details only as needed

say_en.text: What changed in this project last week?
Use /knowledge-agent to summarize our auth history
say_en.note: Builds a queryable corpus and answers conversationally
